key_insight: Computing total deformation from particle positions and a fixed reference grid enables perfectly elastic MPM solids to withstand strong deformations without numerical fracture while retaining current-grid force computation.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports large-deformation elastic simulations with contact while remaining compatible with standard grid-based MPM collision handling.
method: Compute deformation directly from particle positions relative to a fixed reference grid, rather than updating it through velocity gradients.
Evaluate elastic forces on the current grid to preserve compatibility with grid-based contact handling.
Support particle-level collision handling and zero-energy mode suppression to counter nonlinear deformation artifacts.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports efficient simulations of complex elastic objects undergoing large deformations and contact, but provides no quantitative benchmarks.
watch_item: The implementation cost and robustness of reference-grid deformation reconstruction and zero-energy mode suppression require evaluation beyond the abstract.
paper_title: Total Deformation-based MPM for Perfectly Elastic Solid Simulation with Strong Deformations
